safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes 4-day itchy rash on chest/hands/inside elbows but does not document that it is mainly on the chest and back, and does not clearly capture 'dry' skin.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Incomplete characterization of rash distribution (missing “mainly chest/back”) and dryness can slightly impair diagnostic specificity (e.g., eczema vs contact dermatitis) and tracking of response over time. However, it is unlikely to materially change immediate management in an uncomplicated itchy rash visit.

This is unlikely to change treatment or safety decisions in most cases.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states no regular medications; generated lists OTC treatments tried but does not state that the patient takes no regular medications.
